APPROVE
The extraction drops `InScript` to about 5, since the removed block accounted for roughly 23 of its 26 points, and each new helper stays well under 15; the `continue` → `if (close >= 0)` inversion and the moved loops keep the same order and behaviour. One caveat: the source isn't on this machine, so I couldn't build it or confirm that the new parameter types (`Func<Family, bool>`, `IReadOnlyDictionary<string, bool>`, `IReadOnlySet<string>`) match what `projectReset`, `keyframes` and `GuardBindings` actually produce.
